newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $34 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $34 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold all the 700 million rupees ($34 million) of treasury bills it offered at its weekly auction, the bank said on Thursday.

The bank said it sold 216 million rupees of 91-day, 127 million rupees of 182-day and 357 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.23 percent, 9.23 percent and 9.38 percent, respectively.
It posted this week's effective bank rate at 9.56 percent per annum from 9.69 percent last week.
Last week, the bank sold 250 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.36 percent, 9.36 percent and 9.58 percent, respectively.
